$comment: Which Design canvas each board goes to, and the asset ids each canvas holds. Assets are per canvas: an id is only valid on the canvas it was uploaded to. `avatar` is the profile photo (CSS-cropped and ringed by the board); `avatar-baked` is the 96px signature lockup baked as one PNG, circle and ring included, which the Components board and the job-title carousel use.
